name: Privatzimmer Neuleitn
beschreibung: The Privatzimmer Neuleitn is located in a quiet part of Thiersee, surrounded by meadows and mountains of the Tiroler Unterland. The inn is run as a family business and offers simple, well-kept rooms with a view of the surrounding nature. Guests appreciate the quiet location away from the main road as well as the easy access to the surrounding hiking and cycling trails. Breakfast is included in the offer.
